title: Re-order icons in Bolus Wizard
body:
I think it would be nice if the icons in bolus wizard would follow the right order of the detailed list, the actual icons order is BG - TREND - INSULIN - CARBS. I think Insulin should swap with carbs.

![photo 100 18-11-49](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/608650/148956384-8fd3af44-8174-49d0-8e39-0de3ac5810d2.jpg)

comments.body: Good proposal, I'll prepare a PR...
